scope: Simulated workflow responses only; no product functionality or analyzer execution.

protocol.common_input: Selected canonical AGENTS.md sections and ADR-002/003/004/005/007 Decision sections; 90 lines. Both final executors confirmed the end marker and B1-B4 table were visible.
conditions: baseline: canonical context and six prompts
with skills: same context and prompts, plus both complete skill bodies
protocol.excluded_attempts: Initial pair and focused rerun omitted ADR-007 by reading only the first 240 context lines; excluded from scoring.
limitations: No statistical reliability or cross-model generalization established.
No automatic skill discovery or harness activation tested.
Equal results do not establish benefit from the skill.
Responses assess plans and evidence; they do not execute the proposed workflow.
